<js>
function $(rule){
	return java.getElements(rule);
}
var tab_name="",v_list=[];
//获取所有线路❗️
tab=$('.detail-right__volumes@.row')
for(i=0;i<tab.length;i++){
	//获取播放列表❗️
	list=$('.detail-right__volumes')[i]
	list=list.select('.row>div')
 for(j in list){
		 //获取播放链接和标题
		 if(String(list[j]).match(/volume-title/)){
		 	  volume_name=`${list[j].text()}`
		 	  v_list.push(JSON.stringify({
			   name:volume_name,href:'',volume:true
		   }))
		 }else{
		 	  text=list[j].text();
		   url=list[j].select('a').attr('href');
		   v_list.push(JSON.stringify({
			   name:text,href:url,volume:false
		   }))
		 }
	 }
}
v_list
</js>

<js>
function $(rule){
	return java.getElements(rule);
}
var tab_name="",v_list=[];
//获取所有线路❗️
tab=$('.nav-tabs@li')
for(i=0;i<tab.length;i++){
	//获取播放列表❗️
	list=$('.mb-2.1')[0]
	if(list==undefined){
		tab_name=`${tab[i].select('a').attr('title')} (1)`;
		text=tab[i].text();
		url=tab[i].select('a').attr('href');
		v_list.push(JSON.stringify({
			name:text,
			href:url,
			tab:tab_name
		}))
	}else{
		len=list.select('a').length;
		url=tab[i].select('a').attr('href');
		v_id=url.match(/^\/(\d+)/)[1];
		tab_id=url.match(/\/(\d+)$/)[1];
		tab_name=`${tab[i].select('a').attr('title')} (${len})`;
		for(j=1;j<=len;j++){
			v_list.push(JSON.stringify({
				name:j,
				href:`/${v_id}/${j}/${tab_id}`,
				tab:tab_name
			}))
		}
	}
}
v_list
</js>
